info.title: B032 local-dev private storage
info.description: O05. Private server-generated keys, immutable retained byte attempts. 4MiB exact chunks; source max20,000,000B, output max256MiB; real byte/hash verification outside DB transaction. Metadata attachment alone changes verified→ready. Operation lease5min bounded by upload expiry1h; at most2 account/8 instance active operations. No public URLs, parser/model execution or cloud. Cleanup retain-only: no physical deletion authorization or proof. Local HTTP test is not public HTTPS/Nginx/browser-cookie readiness.
